scripts.api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn noma.api.app:app --reload
scripts.check: bun run check:repo && bun run check:backend && bun run check:web
scripts.check:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run pyright && uv run pytest -q
scripts.check:repo: bun run typecheck && bun test scripts/
scripts.check:web: cd web && bun run lint && bun run build
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U noma -d noma
